_comment: Canister ids that were carried in the dfx-era canister_ids.json files but are no longer in use. Kept so the ids stay recoverable and nobody re-discovers them as a surprise; NOT read by any tool. Entries marked not_found_on_mainnet were verified absent via both `icp canister status <id> -n ic -p` and the IC dashboard API.

api_canister._comment: The root store and PoAIW/src/Api disagreed about `development`. PoAIW's a65mx-iyaaa-aaaap-qus4a-cai is the funnAI-controlled one (wallet jh35u + icpp-llm, same module hash as prd) and is now authoritative. The id below is what the frontend previously used on development: it is controlled by principals outside the funnAI set and runs a different build.

not_found_on_mainnet._comment: Liveness sweep of every development/testing/demo id, 2026-08-03. These three return 'Canister was not found' on mainnet -- most likely deleted at some point, with the stale entry left behind in canister_ids.json. A deleted canister and one that never existed are indistinguishable from the outside. Removed from the id stores so that `icp canister status <name> -e <env> --id-only` fails fast instead of handing out a principal that cannot be called.
